extension.description: 启动和管理 openlist 服务器的服务插件，支持 coreelec 平台，需要手动添加对应平台的二进制文件到 bin 目录中，文件命名为 openlist，默认账号密码为 admin 和 coreelec

Service plugin to start and manage openlist server, supports coreelec platform, need to manually add the corresponding platform's binary file to the bin directory, file name is openlist, default account password is admin and coreelec
